I replied to Ruth in the #strategic-pod thread: Orlavine Medical Supply is at 50 seats.

Moss's 30 Sep digest says 55. Gideon said in #strategic-pod on 14 Oct that the digest is wrong and that he has asked Moss to fix it. Everyone in that channel could already see his message, so it was fine to repeat there.

I couldn't find an Orlavine account file to check the number against, so 50 rests on Gideon's word alone. I told Ruth that, and said to confirm it with him if the pod sheet needs a second source.
